description: This file contains a set of utility functions primarily for string manipulation, including functions for calculating string length, searching for substrings, extracting substrings, changing case, generating tokens, and compatibility shims for PHP versions. It also includes comments and annotations explaining each function.

methods.name: oc_strlen
methods.description: Returns the length of a string using multibyte-safe mb_strlen.

methods.name: oc_strpos
methods.description: Finds the position of the first occurrence of a substring within a string, using mb_strpos.

methods.name: oc_strrpos
methods.description: Finds the position of the last occurrence of a substring within a string, using mb_strrpos.

methods.name: oc_substr
methods.description: Extracts a portion of a string based on offset and optional length, using mb_substr.

methods.name: oc_strtoupper
methods.description: Converts a string to uppercase using mb_strtoupper.

methods.name: oc_strtolower
methods.description: Converts a string to lowercase using mb_strtolower.

methods.name: oc_token
methods.description: Generates a random token of specified length, using random_bytes and bin2hex.
